about: Pre-registered 2026-11-25, before any paid call of the bricks pipeline: statements outside FD that a block for the disease must contain, so the pipeline is not tuned to FD alone. Each point is found when an accepted point's quote, from one of the listed documents, contains the phrase (compared after normalisation). The locations were checked by code against snapshot 2026-11-24. Paragraphs are 1-based, as the pipeline shows them. Amended 2026-11-28, before any OI run: the grade A guideline's statement of the same thing (21829228 ¶43) also counts for oi-molecular-testing, because the selection prompt prefers a grade A document.

points.what: with suspected FOP, avoid biopsies and other elective procedures
the diagnosis is clinical but needs genetic confirmation of an ACVR1 variant
the absence of a known family history does not rule OI out

where.phrase: Absence of a known family history does not preclude the diagnosis

points.what: the diagnosis is established by molecular genetic testing of COL1A1/COL1A2

where.phrase: molecular analysis of the COL1A1/2 genes is recommended as the starting point

topics.what: at least one accepted point is about the endocrine work-up at or after diagnosis
topics.rule: the point's section heading or quote matches: endocrin|thyroid|pituitar|growth hormone|gonad|pubert|adrenal|cortisol|phosphat|FGF23
